title: now/v1 — what I'm working on now

asOf.description: Fetch instant, ISO 8601 in UTC. Data, not decoration: consumers compare it to decide staleness.

items.description: Sorted by date desc, then url asc. The order is part of the contract because it is part of the bytes.

kind.description: Closed in v1. A new kind is a new minor of the shape.

url.description: https only: the block is rendered as a link on a public surface.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, absolute, taken from the source (never computed at render time).

source.description: Where the row came from, e.g. github:owner/repo. Provenance, not decoration.
